items.title: You’re a Great Fit for Our Travel Readiness Session
items.description:
Based on your answers, the Travel Readiness Session (GHS400) is the perfect starting point for your trip.
In this personalised 45‑minute 1‑on‑1 session (Google Meet or WhatsApp), I’ll help you:
Confirm destination suitability
Receive your non‑visa travel document checklist
Understand airport & transit flow
Avoid common first‑time traveler mistakes
Get budget guidance and clear next steps
This session is designed to help you feel confident, prepared, and stress‑free.

👉 Step 1: Complete this quick intake form (1–2 minutes)
This gives me the essential details I need to tailor your session.
🔗 Travel Readiness Intake Form
Travel Readiness Session


👉 Step 2: Make payment to confirm your session
After you submit the intake, you’ll see a confirmation page containing your Mobile Money payment details.
You’ll also receive the same payment details via WhatsApp for convenience.

👉 Step 3: Book your session time
Once payment is confirmed, you’ll receive a private booking link to choose your preferred date and time.
Please note: Your session will be scheduled within 48 hours of payment confirmation. Your summary pack will be delivered within 48 hours of your session.
Thank you for choosing Travel With Ease — Your Guide to Stress‑Free Travel.
I look forward to helping you prepare for your journey with clarity and confidence

items.title: You’re a Great Fit for Full Trip Planning
items.description:
Amazing — I'll handle everything end-to-end so you can simply arrive and enjoy.

Full Trip Planning covers the complete journey — destination research, itinerary design, flight and hotel booking, activity and transfer arrangements, and your personalised Travel Pack PDF. Your planning fee covers our service. Actual flight, hotel and activity costs are funded separately via a travel fund request once your itinerary is approved.

Package options:
Full Trip Planning — GHS 2,000
Full end-to-end research, booking and execution for up to 2 destinations. Includes your Travel Pack PDF and one round of revisions.
Premium Concierge — GHS 3,000
Everything in Full Trip Planning, plus up to 4 destinations, priority handling, active WhatsApp support throughout your trip, restaurant reservations (up to 3), and one special occasion arrangement. Unlimited revisions included.
You'll select your package inside the intake form.
Need anything extra? The following add-ons are available and can be selected inside the intake form:
Additional destination — GHS 200 per destination
Restaurant reservation — GHS 100 per reservation
Special Occasion Planning (birthday, anniversary, proposal) — GHS 500
WhatsApp Support Basic — GHS 200 (reactive, within a few hours)
WhatsApp Support Active — GHS 400 (daily check-ins throughout your trip)
Steps:
👉 Step 1: Open the Full Trip Planning Intake Form
Share your trip details so we can tailor your plan. You'll select Full Trip Planning or Premium Concierge inside the form.
🔗 Open the Full Trip Planning Intake Form → Full trip planning form
👉 Step 2: Intake Review
I'll review your form and respond via WhatsApp with:
Your planning timeline
50% deposit amount
Telecel Cash payment instructions
Next steps to begin
👉 Step 3: Confirm with 50% Deposit
Planning begins after your deposit is received. You'll get a confirmation message and your start date via WhatsApp within 1 working day.
👉 Step 4: Travel Fund Request
Once your itinerary is approved, I'll send you a travel fund request covering the total cost of your flights, hotels, activities and transfers. Bookings are made once funds are received.
👉 Step 5: Receive Your Travel Pack
Your completed Travel Pack PDF — itinerary, booking confirmations, budget breakdown, destination notes and tips — will be delivered within 7–10 working days of your planning start date.
The remaining 50% balance is due before delivery.
Premium Concierge clients receive priority handling with delivery in 5–7 working days.
Note:
Your planning start date is confirmed via WhatsApp within 1 working day of deposit. All bookings are made by Travel with Ease on your behalf once your travel fund is received. We do not make any bookings without your written approval of the itinerary first.

items.title: Not Sure? I’ll Help You Decide — In One Step
items.description:
No worries — here’s a quick guide:
Choose Travel Readiness Session if you want advice on destination fit, documents, budget ranges, airport/transit, and mistakes to avoid. (45 min call + summary pack)

Choose Full Trip Planning if you want me to plan the entire experience (itinerary, stays, experiences, logistics, concierge options).
